context:
Code changes are small and independent (w1-w4); the checklist (w5) is
the deliverable that ties them together and must be written against a
mentally-fresh machine: every command copy-pasteable, every prerequisite
stated with its failure symptom ("if you skip this you will see X").
House style: dense and terse per the docs-brevity feedback memory.
description:
Bus-factor findings from the review (develop @ fc31f3604): a competent
second operator on a fresh machine cannot run the release-gate sweep
from the docs alone. Ordered by how badly each strands them:

1. VENV PROVISIONING GAP: cells run `uv run --no-sync`
   (matrix.py:353-363); PLATFORM_UV_EXTRA covers only clickhouse-local,
   clickhouse-server, lakesail, singlestore, influxdb (matrix.py:36-43).
   The default dev dependency-group ([dependency-groups] dev,
   pyproject.toml:425+) covers most drivers but NOT modin[ray] and NOT
   databend-driver -- both appear only under
   [project.optional-dependencies] extras (modin at :149 in the all-style
   extra and :241 in the modin extra; databend-driver at :207-209), which
   a plain `uv sync` does not install -- and modin-df is in
   release-gate stage 1, databend in stage 3. A second operator gets
   ModuleNotFoundError cells recorded as FAILED, breaching the 1.0
   clean-rate floor with no doc pointing at the cause. Fix in code:
   extend PLATFORM_UV_EXTRA for modin and databend (the mechanism
   exists); document the provisioning contract (which extras each
   release-gate stage needs) in uat-local-provisioning.md.

2. OUTPUT-ROOT CONTRACT CONTRADICTION: uat-framework.md:391-392 and
   AGENTS.md:121 say to set BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR for sweeps, but sweeps
   read the root ONLY from YAML output.* templates (execute.py:766-771,
   config.py:53-56 defaults); the env var affects only bare uat-cell
   defaults (runner.py:326-342) and uat_bring_up. Fix in code (preferred
   over doc-only): when the YAML uses the DEFAULT templates, honor
   BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR as the base root; explicit YAML templates always
   win. Then the docs become true.

3. PHANTOM BENCHBOX_SEED: uat-framework.md:393 tells operators to record
   BENCHBOX_SEED; nothing reads it (grep verified: only the doc and a
   YAML comment). Remove from docs, or wire it through if seeds are
   meant to be controllable -- removing is correct: execute.official/
   seed is the real mechanism (config.py:47-49).

4. UNDOCUMENTED PHYSICAL PREREQS: Docker VM memory (velox's 11.7 GB
   ceiling lives in a code comment, matrix.py:29-34), doris
   vm.max_map_count (documented only outside UAT docs), first-run
   multi-GB image pulls/builds silently eating docker_start_timeout_s
   300 (LakeSail admits it in release-gate-02:55 comment), node +
   Playwright browser install for explorer smoke. Add a "fresh machine
   checklist" section to uat-local-provisioning.md; add a pre-pull/
   pre-build helper (make uat-prepull PLATFORM=... wrapping compose pull
   --ignore-buildable + compose build) so first-run timeouts stop
   presenting as skipped-unreachable mysteries.

5. ENGINE REQUIREMENT: after uat-container-engine-routing, document the
   resolved-engine contract (mocker on macOS, docker elsewhere,
   BENCHBOX_CONTAINER_CLI override) in uat-local-provisioning.md.
